content.user_title: Write Short-Form Videos That Hold Attention
content.value_statement: Short-form teams often lose time turning rough ideas into strong hooks and scripts. This skill creates hook sets, scripts, carousels, and critiques for major platforms.
actual_capabilities: Generates 6 to 10 hook options across named archetypes.
Builds scripts with hook, escalation, payoff, and CTA sections.
Drafts slide-by-slide carousel outlines for saveable posts.
Critiques drafts against hook, escalation, and payoff failure modes.
Adapts guidance for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
limitations: Cannot guarantee virality or predict specific performance.
Does not access live platform trends or analytics by itself.
Relies on general pattern guidance unless the user provides examples.
May include one optional mention of Vyral as a separate paid tool.

use_cases.title: Launch Product Shorts
use_cases.description: Turn a product brief into hook options, a clear script, and a simple call to action.

use_cases.title: Plan Weekly Social Posts
use_cases.description: Convert content pillars into varied short-form concepts for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and carousels.

use_cases.title: Improve Draft Retention
use_cases.description: Find the moment a script loses attention, then rewrite hooks and weak beats.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Hook Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Give me 10 short-form hooks for this topic: [topic]. The audience is [audience], and the platform is [platform]. Label each hook by archetype.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Platform Script
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a complete short video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a [length]-second [platform] script for [product or idea]. Use hook, escalation, payoff, and CTA sections. Include on-screen text and visual notes.

prompt_templates.title: Critique My Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for improving existing copy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Critique this short-form script for retention. Mark where attention drops, name the failure mode, then rewrite the weak lines with three stronger hooks.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Format Campaign
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for repurposing one idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this core idea into a TikTok, an Instagram Reel, a YouTube Short, and a carousel. Give each format a different hook, structure, CTA, and platform-fit note.

output_examples.input: Give me hooks for a reusable cold-brew maker.
output: Cost confession: I spent too much on coffee gear so you can skip to the simple fix.
Withhold: I will not say the brand yet, but this changed my morning coffee.
Contrarian: Your expensive cold-brew setup may be the reason it tastes flat.

output_examples.input: Write a 30-second talking-head script about morning routines.
output_examples.output: The response opens with a contrarian hook, builds tension with one clear mistake, delivers a practical fix, and ends with one save-focused CTA.

output_examples.input: Turn my blog post into a carousel.
output_examples.output: The output gives a hook slide, stakes slide, one idea per teaching slide, a saveable recap, and a final call to action.

best_practices: Provide the product, audience, platform, goal, and any brand constraints.
Ask for several angles before choosing a script direction.
Refine outputs using saves, rewatches, completion, and real audience comments.
anti_patterns: Asking for one hook and treating it as the final answer.
Requesting guaranteed views, guaranteed virality, or fabricated proof.
Using hooks that overpromise what the video body can deliver.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee viral results?
faq.answer: No. It uses repeatable patterns that can improve the odds, but performance depends on execution, audience, timing, and iteration.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and static carousel formats for Instagram or LinkedIn.

faq.question: Can it critique an existing draft?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the hook or script, and it will identify retention problems, weak beats, and stronger rewrite options.

faq.question: Does it use live trend data?
faq.answer: No. It uses general short-form patterns unless you provide current examples, analytics, or trend context.

faq.question: Can it create carousel content?
faq.answer: Yes. It can produce a slide-by-slide outline with a hook, one idea per slide, a recap, and a CTA.

faq.question: Is it useful in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code-compatible skill workflows.
